_about: Lines our code adds to the loop's user turns (T1.14, T2.4), outside the cached system prompt. Angle-bracket fields are filled by builder G; fields in double braces are setting names in api/settings.py. Draft by the main session, for the user's review before the first paid run (T1.14). Added Oct 24, 2026 from builder G's drafts, for the same review: unknown_tool, submit_accepted_note, submit_accepted_answer (<passages> is "1 kept passage" or "<n> kept passages"), and the composition request's composition_scope_note and composition_coverage lines (the question line there is first_message). Contract v2.0 (P4.19), drafts for the user's review before Wave 3's first paid run: update_start and update_start_note (the accepted submit_answer's result that opens the update step, with something kept or nothing kept; <passages> as in submit_accepted_answer), status_line without the update count, status_line_update, submit_update_accepted; update_check_unavailable and update_unavailable_reason removed, since research no longer has an update check.
unknown_tool: There is no tool named <name>. The tools are: <tools>.
submit_accepted_note: Submission accepted. No answer will be written from the corpus; the note goes to the visitor.
submit_accepted_answer: Submission accepted. The answer is being written from the <passages>.
update_start: Submission accepted. Research is finished: the answer is being written from the <passages>, and nothing more can be read or kept. Now the update step: check the web with search_web_updates for anything published after the corpus's coverage that bears on the question, or decide that no check is needed. End with submit_update, giving update_findings if you searched or update_skip_reason if you did not. Only search_web_updates and submit_update work from here on.
update_start_note: Submission accepted. Research is finished: no answer will be written from the corpus, and the note goes to the visitor. Now the update step: check the web with search_web_updates for anything published after the corpus's coverage that bears on the question, or decide that no check is needed. End with submit_update, giving update_findings if you searched or update_skip_reason if you did not. Only search_web_updates and submit_update work from here on.
submit_update_accepted: Submission accepted. The update step is finished.
composition_scope_note: Scope note from the research step: <scope_note>
composition_coverage: Coverage: the latest decision in the full pull is <latest_decision_full_pull>, the latest decision in this corpus is <latest_decision_in_corpus>, and the text was ingested on <ingested>.
